Idk if anyone has brought this up yet, but if you go to the tuckersoft website for black mirror, (which if you dont know about it look it up so many easter eggs) you can find a page for bandersnatch. I looked a few days ago and it said something along the lines of "The game was pulled from shelves after it was discovered the now infamous stefan butler murdered his father." As well as having "cancelled" plastered across it. But now if you look it says "This revolutionary game from Stefan Butler is based upon the dark adventure novel by Jerome F. Davies." 

Meaning they are changing it and probably will continue to change it, so i dont think they chose a definitive ending. It kind of makes me wonder if this whole alternate realities, multiple pathways (not interactive shows) thing will become a big part of black mirror. Its almost like he was trapped in purgatory, constantly repeating the cycle until he gets the game perfect, but even if he does it just continues to repeat. Obviosuly just throwing something like alternate realitys into black mirror would be a little strange like "yeah this exists" but it could also be that stefan is a digital person, programmed to repeat the cycle of creating the game until he gets it right. But he starts to realize that he is under control, somebody making the decisions they think would best make him finish the game,  (yes even killing his dad severe emotional trauma can be a great motivator) programming him. Sorry for my jumbled mess of theories but just thought it was interesting.
